title: HMD_LANG_CONFORMANCE_ISSUE_001: hmd mickey build is broken in hmd-img-projectbuilder 0.5.395
body_markdown:
**HMD_LANG_CONFORMANCE_ISSUE_001** — The projectbuilder image pairs hmd-cli-mickey 1.0.52 with hmd-lib-mickey 0.1.3, which fails with "cannot import name 'clean'", so no lang pack can render its code in the standard build image.

**Where**
- [tools/render.sh#L13-L16](https://github.com/NeuronSphere/hmd-lang-conformance/blob/main/tools/render.sh#L13-L16)

**Impact:** Every lang pack's `hmd mickey build` fails in hmd-img-projectbuilder 0.5.395; this repo works around it by installing hmd-cli-mickey 1.1.55 and hmd-lib-mickey 0.2.85 from the private index before rendering.

**Found by:** Rendering this vocabulary for the NERD005 characterization, 2026-10-27; also NERD005 phase 2 (hmd-meta-types corpus).

**Status:** open

**Recommendation:** Publish a projectbuilder image with a matching mickey CLI and library pair, then drop the workaround in tools/render.sh.

Tracked in `docs/known_issues.rst` (HMD_LANG_CONFORMANCE_ISSUE_001).

title: HMD_LANG_CONFORMANCE_ISSUE_002: vocabgen's filter hook used a Jinja API removed in Jinja 3.1
body_markdown:
**HMD_LANG_CONFORMANCE_ISSUE_002** — hmd-tmpl-vocabgen's filter hook imported jinja2.contextfilter, which Jinja 3.1 removed, so no vocabgen template rendered in the current toolchain.

**Where**
- hmd-tmpl-vocabgen `src/mickey/hooks` (fixed in b1b0405)

**Impact:** All vocabgen-based code generation (python_lib, python_client, go_lib, typescript_lib) failed for every lang pack.

**Found by:** NERD005 phase 2 (go_lib corpus), 2026-10-26.

**Status:** fixed in hmd-tmpl-vocabgen b1b0405

**Recommendation:** Done: the hook imports pass_context. Rebuild lang packs that pinned an older vocabgen.

Tracked in `docs/known_issues.rst` (HMD_LANG_CONFORMANCE_ISSUE_002).

title: HMD_LANG_CONFORMANCE_ISSUE_003: Not yet published: consumers install from git
body_markdown:
**HMD_LANG_CONFORMANCE_ISSUE_003** — hmd-lang-conformance is not on the private index yet, so hmd-entity-storage's Bender container installs it from the GitHub repository's src/python subdirectory.

**Where**
- [src/python/setup.py#L1](https://github.com/NeuronSphere/hmd-lang-conformance/blob/main/src/python/setup.py#L1)

**Impact:** Conformance runs need GitHub access from the Bender container (and credentials if the repository is private), and they track main rather than a released version.

**Found by:** Moving the vocabulary out of hmd-entity-storage, 2026-10-27.

**Status:** open

**Recommendation:** Publish 0.1.0 to the private index with `hmd build` and pin hmd-lang-conformance~=0.1 in hmd-entity-storage/test/test_requirements.txt.

Tracked in `docs/known_issues.rst` (HMD_LANG_CONFORMANCE_ISSUE_003).

title: HMD_LANG_CONFORMANCE_ISSUE_004: Lang packs must be baked into the service image
body_markdown:
**HMD_LANG_CONFORMANCE_ISSUE_004** — hmd-ms-base loads a lang pack by importing it, so serving this vocabulary needs a derived hmd-ms-base-test image with the package pip-installed rather than configuration alone.

**Where**
- [docker/Dockerfile.ms-base-test#L1](https://github.com/NeuronSphere/hmd-lang-conformance/blob/main/docker/Dockerfile.ms-base-test#L1)

**Impact:** Every vocabulary change needs an image rebuild and a redeploy; a local nsctl environment also needs the image tagged under the bare and registry-qualified names.

**Found by:** NERD005 characterization on scratch, 2026-10-27.

**Status:** open

**Recommendation:** Consider runtime lang-pack installation (or a lang-pack volume) in hmd-ms-base, and in the Go ms-base from the start.

Tracked in `docs/known_issues.rst` (HMD_LANG_CONFORMANCE_ISSUE_004).

title: HMD_LANG_CONFORMANCE_ISSUE_005: No Go code is generated for the vocabulary yet
body_markdown:
**HMD_LANG_CONFORMANCE_ISSUE_005** — Only the Python package is generated; the go_lib template (fixed in hmd-tmpl-vocabgen b1b0405) is not yet run for this vocabulary, and go_lib does not emit a go.mod.

**Where**
- [tools/render.sh#L1](https://github.com/NeuronSphere/hmd-lang-conformance/blob/main/tools/render.sh#L1)

**Impact:** The Go CRUD service and Go engines (NERD005 phase 3 onward) cannot use these nouns until Go code is generated and importable.

**Found by:** NERD005 phase 2 report, 2026-10-26.

**Status:** deferred to NERD005 phase 3

**Recommendation:** Add go_lib to tools/render.sh, commit src/go with a go.mod, and tag src/go/<module>/v0.1.0.

Tracked in `docs/known_issues.rst` (HMD_LANG_CONFORMANCE_ISSUE_005).
